memory_candidates.content: In this repository, a plan that changes ANY Lean source line count cannot keep its file scope narrow: typst/generated/status.typ's formalsystem-line-count / tests-line-count is enforced by .githooks/pre-commit as a BLOCKING check on any commit whose staged set touches a .lean path, so its regeneration must be staged in the same commit as the Lean change and cannot be deferred to a reconciliation phase. Separately, check-module-invariants.sh --emit-inventory rewrites EVERY README carrying a `<!-- BEGIN GENERATED: inventory -->` block on the edited file's ancestor-directory chain (for a FormalSystem/Metalogic/Decidability/RaySummary/ file that is four READMEs: repo root, FormalSystem/, FormalSystem/Metalogic/, and the RaySummary/ one). plan-file-scope-harvest.sh appends both surface families automatically, so running it against a draft plan at AUTHORING time is a cheap mechanical check that surfaces missed ancestor-chain READMEs before they appear as a red INV finding mid-implementation. Architectural consequence: two concurrent .lean-touching tasks in this repo ALWAYS collide on these shared surfaces and must be serialized by declaration (letting orchestrate-batch-admit.sh see the overlap), never by narrowing a plan's declared scope.
